rationale: A wins by a nose because it keeps the skeptical story alive and labels the proof problem instead of sanding it off. Its “Bank-to-bank payments have flopped at checkout before — does an instant-settlement rail change that?” is the most journalist-shaped angle in either set: tension, history, reporting assignment. B has strong bones, but “FedNow gets a merchant-facing on-ramp through Plaid's 12,000 bank connections” flirts with the classic infrastructure overclaim: Plaid connectivity is not the same as FedNow reach.
gaps_in_A: “company with connections into 12,000+ financial institutions routing merchant payments through instant, FedNow-based settlement” risks conflating Plaid connectivity with actual FedNow availability. A catches the issue later, but the angle text still overreaches.
“Bank-to-bank payments have flopped at checkout before” imports market history not supplied in the update. It is a good angle, but it needs outside sourcing before anyone pitches it as fact.

“FedNow policy/infrastructure-adoption angle ... duplicate” is too broad a refusal. A regulator story is unsupported, but a rails-adoption infrastructure story is viable and B frames that lane better.
“Decay: 24hr” on the large-transaction fee story is too stingy. Fee math can live for a trade explainer after launch day if Plaid supplies the numbers.
gaps_in_B: “covering the card networks' interchange economics and who is trying to erode them” mangles the journalist shape. Reporters are not trying to erode interchange; challengers are.

“FedNow gets a merchant-facing on-ramp through Plaid's 12,000 bank connections” overstates what the facts prove. The update says Plaid connects to 12,000 institutions, not that those institutions support FedNow.
“Pay by bank finally takes off in the US” is rightly refused as a conclusion, but B throws away the better skeptical version. The pitchable angle is the question, not the victory lap.
Only three kept angles, and the missing contrarian lens makes the set less useful for a founder deciding whether this can become more than launch coverage.
